summary: Bank of Montreal filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for an offering of US$ Fixed Rate Reset Limited Recourse Capital Notes, Series 7 (NVCC) and Non-Cumulative 5-Year Fixed Rate Reset Class B Preferred Shares, Series 56. This is a routine capital-raising transaction for regulatory capital (Additional Tier 1), not a special situation. The notes are subordinated indebtedness with limited recourse to trust assets. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is present. The filing is a standard debt and preferred equity shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
